anchor: bare-key read form. The bare form `git config core.hooksPath` therefore blocks as before;
fix: When the blocked form is the bare key with no value, say: 'reading? use git config --get core.hooksPath'. Table test on the message.
how: codesift session 2026-11-02: 'git config core.hooksPath; ls memory/reviews ...' blocked with 'git --no-verify / commit -n / hook-path override skips hooks'; the agent removed the read and never looked at the hook layer. Re-tested on origin/main 2026-11-03: bare form exit 2, --get form exit 0.
title: block-no-verify refuses the bare read 'git config core.hooksPath' (by design) but its message does not name the allowed read form, so the agent drops the check instead

fix: Print 'bad-source: <value> — expected [drive-by:]a-z0-9- (no colon or slash), e.g. drive-by:review' in the refusal; same for bad-target/bad-path. Contract test on the text.
how: codesift session 2026-11-02: the auto-prune flake finding was refused 'bad-source' and went to the ledger only; the accepted form ([drive-by:]lowercase-dashes, _SOURCE_RE) was found only by reading the source a day later.
title: backlog-add answers 'REFUSED bad-source' without the accepted pattern, so a caller guesses (a colon in 'zuvo:...' is the usual cause)

fix: Let the driver take --prior-triage <file> (the review artifact's Rejected line) and add it to the prompt: 'rejected with reasons; raise again only with a new argument'. Measure repeats per round before and after.
how: codesift PR #81 (auto-prune overlap), proofs auto-prune-overlap.txt / -2.txt: 'inFlight stuck if the check never settles', 'stop() does not abort', 'cross-process race' rejected with reasons after round 1 and raised again by 3 of 5 round-2 reviewers, two of them as CRITICAL.
title: Round 2 of adversarial review re-raises findings rejected in round 1 with reasons, so each round's triage repeats the same rejections
